product.summary: Separately distributed BlueWallet desktop application; current first-party material directly documents the macOS build.
product.notes: BlueWallet's first-party 2020-08-28 article announces that BlueWallet for Desktop was out on the Mac Store and explicitly calls it the team's first desktop product. WLR therefore records the public desktop launch at day precision on 2020-08-28. The reviewed launch source establishes macOS availability only; earlier implementation work is not used to backdate the public launch.
